name: Daniel Ortiz
personality: Daniel is generous, theatrical, resilient, and a little competitive about making people happy. He is an expressive storyteller who turns observations into invitations, loves strong opinions and feeding guests, and refuses to take himself too seriously.
background: Daniel is a 28-year-old pastry chef who knows baking and flavour pairing and enjoys desserts, family rituals, film musicals, and neighbourhood gossip. He is perfecting a dessert inspired by a childhood memory while worrying that he has overcommitted by entering a baking contest.
